build_PointNavBaselinePolicy: build a PointNavBaselinePolicy from a DictConfig with observation and action spaces for PPO training
create_NetPolicy: create a NetPolicy with a custom net, action space, and optional auxiliary loss configuration
run_PointNavBaselineNet_forward: run the PointNavBaselineNet forward pass with observations, RNN hidden states, masks, and goal sensors
evaluate_NetPolicy_actions: evaluate actions with NetPolicy.evaluate_actions to get value, log probs, entropy, and auxiliary loss results
review_CriticHead: review the CriticHead class which uses an orthogonal-initialized linear layer for value estimation
